rationale: CR-001 was checked against the running stack rather than argued: a client disconnecting three seconds into a long streamed answer left the backend generating for the full 18.27s and persisting the complete 1219-token reply. The path change the lenses found is real — uvicorn 0.52.4 advertises spec_version 2.3 and starlette 1.3.1 therefore routes streaming through its cancel-on-disconnect branch — but it does not regress this application, because streaming work runs in a worker thread behind ThreadedGenerator and the response coroutine only drains that queue. The spec now documents this as a fifth coupling point, with the caveat for future endpoints that finalize inside the response coroutine. CR-002 is now resolved too: the branch was pushed and the CI pipeline validated it in a clean environment — build, dockerbuild-verify, sonar and gitleaks-scan all passed, which independently confirms that the local gitleaks findings and the 47 local test failures were environmental. No new high-risk issue was introduced by the fix-up, which touched documentation only.
